responsibility: This is the main declaration-processing and scope-management implementation for the C front end. It builds and enters declarations and types, manages identifier/tag bindings and parser-lifetime state, tracks function-return and statement-context flags, handles builtins and address-space keywords, supports OpenMP reduction and declare-target bookkeeping, and performs end-of-translation-unit cleanup and global declaration wrapup before handing the front end’s declarations to later compiler stages.
